DROP VIEW IF EXISTS pf1_classified;
DROP VIEW IF EXISTS pf1_selected;

CREATE VIEW pf1_selected AS
WITH approved_runs AS (
  -- APPROVAL FILTERING HAPPENS HERE, BEFORE any latest-run choice.
  SELECT r.*
    FROM public.sroi_calculation_runs r
   WHERE r.status = 'calculated'
     AND EXISTS (
           SELECT 1
             FROM public.sroi_run_reviews v
            WHERE v.calculation_run_id = r.id
              AND v.organization_id = r.organization_id
              AND v.status = 'approved'
         )
),
selected_run AS (
  -- Latest APPROVED run per project. version DESC is already total per
  -- project through uq_sroi_run_project_version; calculated_at DESC is a
  -- defensive second key that the uniqueness makes unreachable.
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (a.project_id) a.*
    FROM approved_runs a
   ORDER BY a.project_id, a.version DESC, a.calculated_at DESC
),
selected_review AS (
  -- created_at DESC, id DESC. NEVER reviewed_at: it is nullable and DESC
  -- sorts NULLs FIRST, so an unstamped approved review would win.
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (v.calculation_run_id) v.*
    FROM public.sroi_run_reviews v
    JOIN selected_run s
      ON s.id = v.calculation_run_id
     AND s.organization_id = v.organization_id
   WHERE v.status = 'approved'
   ORDER BY v.calculation_run_id, v.created_at DESC, v.id DESC
)
SELECT p.id                AS project_id,
       p.name              AS project_name,
       p.portfolio_id      AS portfolio_id,
       p.organization_id   AS organization_id,
       p.governance_regime AS governance_regime,
       s.id                AS run_id,
       s.version           AS run_version,
       s.methodology_version AS methodology_version,
       s.currency          AS currency,
       s.total_investment  AS total_investment,
       s.net_social_value  AS net_social_value,
       s.sroi_ratio        AS sroi_ratio,
       rv.id               AS review_id,
       rv.readiness_score  AS readiness_score,
       (SELECT count(*)
          FROM public.sroi_calculation_runs cr
         WHERE cr.project_id = p.id
           AND cr.organization_id = p.organization_id
           AND cr.status = 'calculated') AS calculated_run_count
  FROM public.projects p
  LEFT JOIN selected_run s
         ON s.project_id = p.id
        AND s.organization_id = p.organization_id
  LEFT JOIN selected_review rv
         ON rv.calculation_run_id = s.id
 WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL;

CREATE VIEW pf1_classified AS
SELECT x.*,
       CASE
         WHEN x.run_id IS NULL AND x.calculated_run_count = 0 THEN 'no_run'
         WHEN x.run_id IS NULL                                THEN 'no_approved_run'
         WHEN x.net_social_value IS NULL                      THEN 'no_run'
         WHEN x.governance_regime = 'pre_pc01b'
           OR x.methodology_version IS NULL                   THEN 'legacy_non_authoritative'
         WHEN coalesce(x.currency, 'USD') <> 'USD'            THEN 'non_usd_currency'
         WHEN x.sroi_ratio IS NULL                            THEN 'no_sroi_ratio'
         WHEN x.total_investment IS NULL
           OR x.total_investment <= 0                         THEN 'zero_or_invalid_investment'
         ELSE NULL
       END AS exclusion_reason
  FROM pf1_selected x;

DO $v$ DECLARE n int; BEGIN
  SELECT count(*) INTO n FROM pf1_classified WHERE portfolio_id = 'c0f10000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001';
  IF n <> 14 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PG-PF1-00 the main portfolio holds % project(s), expected 14 — the fixture did not land', n; END IF;
END $v$;
